column2:
lake(n.)湖
(無詞性變化)
Sun Moon Lake 日月潭
by the lake 在湖邊
We had a picnic by the lake.
(我們在湖邊野餐。)
Sun Moon Lake is very beautiful.
(日月潭非常美麗。)

lamp(n.)燈、檯燈
(無詞性變化)
desk lamp 檯燈
turn on the lamp 打開燈
Please turn on the lamp.
(請把燈打開。)
I read under the desk lamp.
(我在檯燈下看書。)

land(n./v.)陸地、土地、降落、登陸
landing(n.)降落、著陸
by land 經由陸路
land safely 安全降落
The plane landed at ten o'clock.
(飛機在十點降落。)
Farmers work hard on the land.
(農夫們在土地上辛勤工作。)

language(n.)語言
(無詞性變化)
foreign language 外語
body language 肢體語言
English is an international language.
(英文是一種國際語言。)
How many languages can you speak?
(你會說幾種語言？)

large(adj.)大的、大量的
largely(adv.)大部分、主要地
a large number of 大量的
large size 大尺寸
I'd like a large coffee, please.
(我要一杯大杯咖啡。)
They live in a large house.
(他們住在一棟大房子裡。)

last(n./v./adv./adj.)最後的、上一個的、持續、最後
lasting(adj.)持久的
last week 上週
at last 終於
At last, the rain stopped.
(雨終於停了。)
The meeting lasted two hours.
(會議持續了兩個小時。)

late(adj./adv.)遲的、晚的、已故的、晚地
lately(adv.)最近
be late for 遲到
stay up late 熬夜
Don't be late for school.
(上學不要遲到。)
He stayed up late last night.
(他昨晚熬夜。)

later(adv.)稍後、後來
(無詞性變化)
see you later 待會見
sooner or later 遲早
I will call you later.
(我晚點打電話給你。)
Two days later, he came back.
(兩天後，他回來了。)

laugh(v./n.)笑、笑聲
laughter(n.)笑聲
laugh at 嘲笑
burst out laughing 突然大笑
Don't laugh at other people.
(不要嘲笑別人。)
His jokes always make us laugh.
(他的笑話總是讓我們發笑。)

lawyer(n.)律師
law(n.)法律
become a lawyer 成為律師
hire a lawyer 請律師
She wants to be a lawyer.
(她想當律師。)
My uncle is a lawyer in Taipei.
(我叔叔是台北的律師。)

lazy(adj.)懶惰的
laziness(n.)懶惰
lazy person 懶人
feel lazy 懶洋洋的
Don't be so lazy!
(別那麼懶惰！)
I feel lazy on Sunday mornings.
(星期天早上我總是懶洋洋的。)

lead(v./n.)帶領、導致、領先、鉛
leader(n.)領導者
leadership(n.)領導能力
lead to 導致、通往
take the lead 帶頭、領先
This road leads to the station.
(這條路通往車站。)
Our team took the lead.
(我們隊伍取得領先。)

leader(n.)領導者、隊長
lead(v.)帶領
leadership(n.)領導能力
team leader 組長、隊長
world leader 世界領袖
She is the leader of our group.
(她是我們這組的組長。)
A good leader listens to others.
(好的領導者會傾聽別人。)

learn(v.)學習、得知
learner(n.)學習者
learning(n.)學習
learn from 向…學習
learn a lesson 學到教訓
I want to learn to play the guitar.
(我想學彈吉他。)
We can learn from our mistakes.
(我們可以從錯誤中學習。)

least(adv./pron./adj.)最少、最小
(無詞性變化)
at least 至少
last but not least 最後但同樣重要的
You should sleep at least eight hours.
(你應該至少睡八個小時。)
Math is my least favorite subject.
(數學是我最不喜歡的科目。)

leave(v./n.)離開、留下、遺忘、休假
(無詞性變化)
leave for 動身前往
leave a message 留言
The train leaves at eight.
(火車八點出發。)
I left my bag on the bus.
(我把包包忘在公車上了。)

left(adj./n./adv.)左邊的、左邊、向左
(無詞性變化)
turn left 左轉
on the left 在左邊
Turn left at the corner.
(在轉角處左轉。)
The library is on your left.
(圖書館在你的左手邊。)

leg(n.)腿
(無詞性變化)
break a leg 祝好運(演出前)
long legs 長腿
He hurt his leg playing soccer.
(他踢足球時傷了腿。)
A spider has eight legs.
(蜘蛛有八隻腳。)

lemon(n.)檸檬
lemonade(n.)檸檬汁、檸檬水
lemon tea 檸檬茶
lemon juice 檸檬汁
I'd like a cup of lemon tea.
(我想要一杯檸檬茶。)
Add some lemon juice to the fish.
(在魚上加一點檸檬汁。)

less(pron./adv./adj./prep.)較少、更少、減去
lessen(v.)減少
less than 少於
more or less 或多或少、大約
I spent less money this month.
(我這個月花的錢比較少。)
It takes less than ten minutes.
(這花不到十分鐘。)

lesson(n.)課、一堂課、教訓
(無詞性變化)
piano lesson 鋼琴課
learn a lesson 學到教訓
I have a piano lesson on Monday.
(我星期一有鋼琴課。)
Let's begin Lesson Three.
(我們開始上第三課。)

let(v.)讓、允許
(無詞性變化)
let go 放手
let me know 讓我知道
Let me help you.
(讓我幫你。)
My parents let me go to the concert.
(我爸媽讓我去聽演唱會。)

letter(n.)信、字母
(無詞性變化)
write a letter 寫信
capital letter 大寫字母
I wrote a letter to my pen pal.
(我寫了一封信給我的筆友。)
There are 26 letters in English.
(英文有二十六個字母。)

level(n./adj.)程度、等級、水平的、同高度的
(無詞性變化)
sea level 海平面
high level 高水準
My English level is not high.
(我的英文程度不高。)
He passed the first level of the game.
(他通過了遊戲的第一關。)

library(n.)圖書館
librarian(n.)圖書館員
school library 學校圖書館
borrow books from the library 從圖書館借書
I borrow books from the library.
(我從圖書館借書。)
Please be quiet in the library.
(在圖書館裡請保持安靜。)

lie(v./n.)躺、位於、說謊、謊言
liar(n.)說謊者
tell a lie 說謊
lie down 躺下
Don't tell lies.
(不要說謊。)
I lay on the bed and rested.
(我躺在床上休息。)

life(n.)生命、生活、人生
live(v.)生活、居住
lively(adj.)活潑的、熱鬧的
daily life 日常生活
save one's life 救某人一命
Life in the city is busy.
(城市生活很忙碌。)
The doctor saved his life.
(醫生救了他一命。)

light(n./adj./v./adv.)光、燈、輕的、明亮的、點燃
lightly(adv.)輕輕地
lighten(v.)減輕、照亮
turn off the light 關燈
traffic light 紅綠燈
Please turn off the light.
(請關燈。)
This bag is very light.
(這個包包很輕。)

like(prep./v./n.)像、喜歡、喜好
likely(adj.)可能的
dislike(v./n.)不喜歡
look like 看起來像
would like 想要
I like to play basketball.
(我喜歡打籃球。)
She looks like her mother.
(她長得像她媽媽。)

line(n./v.)線、排隊的行列、台詞、排成一列
(無詞性變化)
stand in line 排隊
draw a line 畫一條線
We stood in line for the bus.
(我們排隊等公車。)
Draw a line under the new words.
(在生字下面畫線。)

lion(n.)獅子
lioness(n.)母獅子
a pride of lions 一群獅子
lion dance 舞獅
The lion is the king of animals.
(獅子是萬獸之王。)
We saw a lion dance at the temple.
(我們在廟口看了舞獅表演。)

lip(n.)嘴唇
(無詞性變化)
lip balm 護唇膏
bite one's lip 咬嘴唇
My lips are dry in winter.
(冬天我的嘴唇很乾。)
She put on some lip balm.
(她擦了一些護唇膏。)

list(n./v.)清單、名單、列出
(無詞性變化)
shopping list 購物清單
make a list 列清單
Mom made a shopping list.
(媽媽列了一張購物清單。)
Please list three things you like.
(請列出三件你喜歡的事。)

listen(v.)聽、傾聽
listener(n.)聽眾、傾聽者
listen to 聽…
listen carefully 仔細聽
I like to listen to music.
(我喜歡聽音樂。)
Please listen to the teacher.
(請聽老師說話。)

little(adj./adv./n.)小的、少的、稍微、一點點
(無詞性變化)
a little 一點點
little by little 逐漸地
I can speak a little Japanese.
(我會說一點日文。)
She has a little brother.
(她有一個弟弟。)

live(v./adj.)居住、生活、活的、現場直播的
living(adj./n.)活的、生計
lively(adj.)活潑的
live in 住在…
live music 現場音樂
I live in Taipei.
(我住在台北。)
They watched the game live on TV.
(他們看電視上的比賽實況轉播。)

lonely(adj.)孤單的、寂寞的
loneliness(n.)寂寞
feel lonely 感到寂寞
lonely life 孤單的生活
I feel lonely when you are away.
(你不在時我感到寂寞。)
The old man lives a lonely life.
(那位老人過著孤單的生活。)

long(adj./adv./v.)長的、長久地、渴望
length(n.)長度
a long time 很長的時間
long for 渴望
She has long hair.
(她留著長頭髮。)
I haven't seen you for a long time.
(好久不見。)

look(v./n.)看、看起來、看一眼
(無詞性變化)
look for 尋找
take a look 看一看
What are you looking for?
(你在找什麼？)
You look tired today.
(你今天看起來很累。)

lose(v.)遺失、輸掉、減少
loss(n.)損失
loser(n.)輸家
lose weight 減重
lose a game 輸掉比賽
I lost my wallet yesterday.
(我昨天弄丟了錢包。)
Our team lost the game.
(我們隊輸了比賽。)

lot(n.)許多、一塊地、命運
(無詞性變化)
a lot of 許多
parking lot 停車場
I have a lot of homework today.
(我今天有很多作業。)
Thanks a lot!
(非常感謝！)

loud(adv./adj.)大聲地、大聲的、吵鬧的
loudly(adv.)大聲地
loud music 吵鬧的音樂
read out loud 大聲朗讀
The music is too loud.
(音樂太大聲了。)
Please read the story out loud.
(請大聲朗讀這個故事。)

love(n./v.)愛、喜愛
lovely(adj.)可愛的、美好的
lover(n.)愛人、愛好者
fall in love 墜入愛河
love to 很喜歡做…
I love my family.
(我愛我的家人。)
She loves to sing.
(她很喜歡唱歌。)

lovely(adj.)可愛的、美好的、令人愉快的
love(n./v.)愛
lovely day 美好的一天
lovely smile 迷人的笑容
What a lovely day!
(天氣真好！)
She has a lovely smile.
(她有迷人的笑容。)

low(adj./adv./n.)低的、低地、低點
lower(v.)降低
low price 低價
low voice 低沉的聲音
The prices here are low.
(這裡的價格很低。)
He spoke in a low voice.
(他低聲說話。)

lucky(adj.)幸運的
luck(n.)運氣
luckily(adv.)幸運地
lucky number 幸運數字
lucky day 幸運日
Seven is my lucky number.
(七是我的幸運數字。)
You are lucky to have such good friends.
(你很幸運有這麼好的朋友。)

lunch(n./v.)午餐、吃午餐
(無詞性變化)
have lunch 吃午餐
lunch box 便當盒
What did you have for lunch?
(你午餐吃了什麼？)
We eat lunch at school.
(我們在學校吃午餐。)

machine(n./v.)機器、用機器加工
machinery(n.)機械(總稱)
washing machine 洗衣機
vending machine 自動販賣機
I bought a drink from the vending machine.
(我從自動販賣機買了一瓶飲料。)
The washing machine is broken.
(洗衣機壞了。)

mad(adj.)生氣的、瘋狂的、著迷的
madly(adv.)瘋狂地
madness(n.)瘋狂
be mad at 對…生氣
go mad 發瘋
Are you still mad at me?
(你還在生我的氣嗎？)
He is mad about soccer.
(他對足球很著迷。)

magic(adj./n.)魔術的、神奇的、魔術、魔法
magical(adj.)神奇的
magician(n.)魔術師
magic trick 魔術把戲
like magic 神奇地
He showed us a magic trick.
(他表演了一個魔術給我們看。)
The medicine worked like magic.
(這藥神奇地見效了。)

mail(n./v.)郵件、郵寄
mailbox(n.)信箱
mailman(n.)郵差
send mail 寄信
by mail 用郵寄方式
I got some mail today.
(我今天收到一些郵件。)
Please mail this letter for me.
(請幫我寄這封信。)

main(adj./n.)主要的、總管道
mainly(adv.)主要地
main idea 主旨
main road 幹道
What is the main idea of this story?
(這個故事的主旨是什麼？)
The main gate of the school is closed.
(學校的大門關著。)

make(v.)做、製造、使得
maker(n.)製造者
make friends 交朋友
make a mistake 犯錯
She makes friends easily.
(她很容易交到朋友。)
The movie made me cry.
(這部電影讓我哭了。)

man(n./v.)男人、人類、為…配置人手
men(n.)男人(複數)
mankind(n.)人類
young man 年輕男子
an old man 老先生
The man in the blue shirt is my teacher.
(穿藍色襯衫的那位男士是我的老師。)
An old man sat on the bench.
(一位老先生坐在長椅上。)

many(adj./pron.)許多的、許多人(事物)
(無詞性變化)
how many 多少
many times 很多次
How many books do you have?
(你有多少本書？)
Many people like this song.
(很多人喜歡這首歌。)

map(n./v.)地圖、繪製地圖
(無詞性變化)
world map 世界地圖
read a map 看地圖
Can you read a map?
(你會看地圖嗎？)
There is a world map on the wall.
(牆上有一張世界地圖。)

mark(n./v.)記號、分數、痕跡、標記
marker(n.)麥克筆、標記
question mark 問號
full marks 滿分
He got full marks on the test.
(他考試拿了滿分。)
Mark the important words in red.
(用紅色標出重要的字。)

market(n./v.)市場、行銷、銷售
marketing(n.)行銷
night market 夜市
go to the market 去市場
Let's go to the night market tonight.
(我們今晚去逛夜市吧。)
Grandma buys vegetables at the market.
(奶奶在市場買菜。)

married(adj.)已婚的
marry(v.)結婚
marriage(n.)婚姻
get married 結婚
be married to 與…結婚
My sister got married last year.
(我姊姊去年結婚了。)
Are your parents married?
(你的父母結婚了嗎？)

mathematics(n.)數學
math(n.)數學(口語)
mathematical(adj.)數學的
math test 數學考試
good at math 擅長數學
I am good at math.
(我擅長數學。)
We have a math test tomorrow.
(我們明天有數學考試。)

matter(n./v.)事情、問題、物質、要緊
(無詞性變化)
What's the matter? 怎麼了?
no matter what 無論什麼
What's the matter with you?
(你怎麼了？)
It doesn't matter.
(沒關係。)

may(aux.)可以、可能、祝願
might(aux.)可能(may 的過去式)
may I...? 我可以…嗎?
may be 可能是
May I come in?
(我可以進來嗎？)
It may rain tomorrow.
(明天可能會下雨。)

maybe(adv.)也許、大概
(無詞性變化)
maybe later 也許晚點
maybe not 也許不會
Maybe he is sick today.
(也許他今天生病了。)
Maybe we can go tomorrow.
(也許我們明天可以去。)

meal(n.)一餐、餐點
(無詞性變化)
have a meal 吃飯
three meals a day 一日三餐
Don't skip your meals.
(不要不吃正餐。)
We had a big meal at the restaurant.
(我們在餐廳吃了一頓大餐。)

mean(v./adj.)意思是、打算、刻薄的、小氣的
meaning(n.)意義
meaningful(adj.)有意義的
mean to 打算、故意
be mean to 對…刻薄
What does this word mean?
(這個字是什麼意思？)
Don't be mean to your sister.
(不要對你妹妹那麼刻薄。)

meat(n.)肉
(無詞性變化)
eat meat 吃肉
fresh meat 新鮮的肉
She doesn't eat meat.
(她不吃肉。)
This meat is very fresh.
(這塊肉很新鮮。)

media(n.)媒體
medium(n.)媒介(單數)
social media 社群媒體
mass media 大眾傳播媒體
Many teens use social media every day.
(很多青少年每天使用社群媒體。)
The news spread fast through the media.
(這則新聞透過媒體迅速傳開。)

medicine(n.)藥、醫學
medical(adj.)醫療的、醫學的
take medicine 吃藥
study medicine 讀醫科
Take this medicine after meals.
(這個藥飯後服用。)
My cousin studies medicine.
(我表哥讀醫科。)

medium(adj.)中等的、適中的
media(n.)媒體(複數)
medium size 中等尺寸
medium rare 三分熟
I want a medium coffee.
(我要一杯中杯咖啡。)
He is of medium height.
(他身高中等。)

meet(v.)遇見、會面、認識
meeting(n.)會議
meet a friend 和朋友見面
Nice to meet you. 很高興認識你。
Nice to meet you.
(很高興認識你。)
Let's meet at the station at five.
(我們五點在車站見面吧。)

meeting(n.)會議、集會
meet(v.)會面
have a meeting 開會
class meeting 班會
We have a class meeting on Friday.
(我們星期五有班會。)
The meeting will start at nine.
(會議九點開始。)

member(n.)成員、會員
membership(n.)會員資格
family member 家庭成員
club member 社員
There are five members in my family.
(我家有五個人。)
He is a member of the tennis club.
(他是網球社的社員。)

menu(n.)菜單
(無詞性變化)
on the menu 在菜單上
look at the menu 看菜單
Can I see the menu, please?
(可以給我看一下菜單嗎？)
Fried rice is not on the menu.
(炒飯不在菜單上。)

middle(adj./n.)中間的、中間
(無詞性變化)
in the middle of 在…的中間
middle school 國中
There is a table in the middle of the room.
(房間中間有一張桌子。)
He woke up in the middle of the night.
(他半夜醒來。)

milk(n.)牛奶、乳汁
milky(adj.)乳白色的、含奶的
a glass of milk 一杯牛奶
milk tea 奶茶
I drink a glass of milk every morning.
(我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。)
Bubble milk tea is popular in Taiwan.
(珍珠奶茶在台灣很受歡迎。)

million(n.)百萬
millionaire(n.)百萬富翁
millions of 數百萬的
one million dollars 一百萬元
Millions of people visit Taipei every year.
(每年有數百萬人造訪台北。)
The house costs ten million dollars.
(那棟房子要價一千萬元。)

mind(n./v.)心智、頭腦、介意
(無詞性變化)
change one's mind 改變主意
Never mind. 沒關係。
Do you mind if I sit here?
(你介意我坐這裡嗎？)
Never mind. It's not your fault.
(沒關係，不是你的錯。)

mine(n./v.)我的(東西)、礦坑、採礦
miner(n.)礦工
a friend of mine 我的一個朋友
gold mine 金礦
This book is mine.
(這本書是我的。)
He is a friend of mine.
(他是我的一個朋友。)

minute(n.)分鐘、片刻
(無詞性變化)
wait a minute 等一下
in a minute 馬上
Wait a minute, please.
(請等一下。)
The bus comes every ten minutes.
(公車每十分鐘來一班。)

miss(v./n.)想念、錯過、未擊中、失誤
missing(adj.)遺失的、失蹤的
miss the bus 錯過公車
miss home 想家
I missed the bus this morning.
(我今天早上錯過了公車。)
I miss my grandma very much.
(我非常想念我奶奶。)

mistake(n./v.)錯誤、誤會、弄錯
mistaken(adj.)弄錯的
make a mistake 犯錯
by mistake 錯誤地、不小心
Everyone makes mistakes.
(每個人都會犯錯。)
I took your umbrella by mistake.
(我不小心拿錯了你的雨傘。)

modern(adj.)現代的、時髦的
modernize(v.)使現代化
modern art 現代藝術
modern life 現代生活
Taipei 101 is a modern building.
(台北101是一棟現代建築。)
Cellphones are part of modern life.
(手機是現代生活的一部分。)

moment(n.)片刻、時刻
(無詞性變化)
at the moment 此刻、目前
for a moment 一會兒
Please wait a moment.
(請稍等一下。)
He is busy at the moment.
(他此刻正在忙。)

money(n.)錢
(無詞性變化)
save money 存錢
spend money 花錢
I want to save money for a new bike.
(我想存錢買新腳踏車。)
Don't spend too much money.
(不要花太多錢。)

monkey(n.)猴子
(無詞性變化)
Formosan rock monkey 台灣獼猴
monkey around 胡鬧
The monkey is eating a banana.
(那隻猴子正在吃香蕉。)
Stop monkeying around in class.
(上課別胡鬧了。)

month(n.)月、月份
monthly(adj./adv.)每月的、每月一次
next month 下個月
once a month 一個月一次
We will move next month.
(我們下個月要搬家。)
I visit my grandparents once a month.
(我一個月去看我的祖父母一次。)

moon(n.)月亮
(無詞性變化)
full moon 滿月
Moon Festival 中秋節
The moon is very bright tonight.
(今晚的月亮很亮。)
We eat moon cakes at the Moon Festival.
(我們在中秋節吃月餅。)

more(adj./pron./adv.)更多的、更多、更
(無詞性變化)
more and more 越來越多
once more 再一次
Would you like some more rice?
(你要再來點飯嗎？)
Please say it once more.
(請再說一次。)

morning(n.)早上、上午
(無詞性變化)
good morning 早安
in the morning 在早上
Good morning, everyone!
(大家早安！)
I go jogging in the morning.
(我早上去慢跑。)

most(adv./pron./adj.)最、大部分、最多的
mostly(adv.)大多、主要地
most of 大部分的…
at most 最多
Most of my friends like music.
(我大部分的朋友都喜歡音樂。)
This is the most beautiful park in town.
(這是鎮上最漂亮的公園。)

mother(n.)母親、媽媽
motherhood(n.)母親身分
Mother's Day 母親節
mother tongue 母語
My mother is a nurse.
(我媽媽是護理師。)
We bought flowers for Mother's Day.
(我們買了花過母親節。)

mountain(n.)山、大量
mountainous(adj.)多山的
climb a mountain 爬山
mountain bike 登山車
Jade Mountain is the highest mountain in Taiwan.
(玉山是台灣最高的山。)
We climbed the mountain on Sunday.
(我們星期天去爬山。)

mouse(n.)老鼠、滑鼠
mice(n.)老鼠(複數)
computer mouse 電腦滑鼠
click the mouse 按滑鼠
The cat caught a mouse.
(貓抓到一隻老鼠。)
Click the mouse twice.
(按兩下滑鼠。)

mouth(n./v.)嘴巴、出口、做嘴型說
(無詞性變化)
open one's mouth 張開嘴
word of mouth 口耳相傳
Open your mouth and say 'Ah.'
(張開嘴巴說「啊」。)
Don't talk with your mouth full.
(嘴裡有食物時不要說話。)

move(v.)移動、搬家、感動
movement(n.)動作、運動、移動
moving(adj.)感人的
move to 搬到…
move on 繼續前進
We moved to Taichung last year.
(我們去年搬到台中。)
Her dance movements are beautiful.
(她的舞蹈動作很優美。)

movie(n.)電影
film(n./v.)電影、底片、拍攝
go to the movies 去看電影
movie star 電影明星
Let's go to the movies tonight.
(我們今晚去看電影吧。)
This film is about a brave girl.
(這部電影是關於一位勇敢的女孩。)

Mr.(n.)先生(用於男子姓氏前)
Mister(n.)先生(全稱)
Mr. Wang 王先生
Mr. Right 理想的另一半
Mr. Lin is our English teacher.
(林老師是我們的英文老師。)
Excuse me, Mr. Chen.
(陳先生，不好意思。)

Mrs.(n.)太太、夫人(用於已婚女子姓氏前)
(無詞性變化)
Mrs. Lee 李太太
Mr. and Mrs. Wang 王先生和王太太
Mrs. Brown lives next door.
(布朗太太住在隔壁。)
Mr. and Mrs. Wang have two kids.
(王先生和王太太有兩個孩子。)

Ms.(n.)女士(用於女子姓氏前,不分婚否)
(無詞性變化)
Ms. Chen 陳女士
Dear Ms. Smith 親愛的史密斯女士
Ms. Chang teaches us music.
(張老師教我們音樂。)
Please give this to Ms. Lin.
(請把這個交給林女士。)

much(adj./pron./adv.)許多的、許多、非常
(無詞性變化)
how much 多少(錢)
too much 太多
How much is this shirt?
(這件襯衫多少錢？)
Thank you very much.
(非常謝謝你。)

mud(n.)泥巴、泥土
muddy(adj.)泥濘的
covered in mud 滿身泥巴
mud bath 泥巴浴
My shoes are covered in mud.
(我的鞋子沾滿了泥巴。)
The kids played in the mud.
(孩子們在泥巴裡玩。)

museum(n.)博物館、美術館
(無詞性變化)
National Palace Museum 故宮博物院
art museum 美術館
We visited the National Palace Museum.
(我們參觀了故宮博物院。)
The museum opens at nine.
(博物館九點開門。)

music(n.)音樂
musical(adj./n.)音樂的、音樂劇
musician(n.)音樂家
listen to music 聽音樂
pop music 流行音樂
I listen to music every night.
(我每天晚上聽音樂。)
She likes pop music.
(她喜歡流行音樂。)

must(aux./n.)必須、一定、必備之物
(無詞性變化)
must be 一定是
a must 必做之事、必備品
You must finish your homework first.
(你必須先寫完作業。)
He must be tired after the long trip.
(長途旅行後他一定很累。)
